column2: `/design` pause-save still publishes design logs without first capturing `session-transcript.jsonl`. the existing plan covers step 5c and clarify, but the pause `design log-publish` entry point can still emit `larch-logs/design/<run_id>/` without a transcript.

step 18 finalize rehydrates `run_id` from the wrong session-env key. production session-env writes `larch_run_id`, so when the shell export is empty the safety nets skip and the run can reach teardown without `session-transcript.jsonl`.

standalone `/review` capture is staged under the cleanup tmpdir, so the transcript can be deleted before it becomes corpus-visible. the capture also depends on `larch_claude_source_file`, which fresh standalone runs do not materialize unless step 0 creates it.

the standalone review capture path has no explicit guard against nested `/review` inside `/implement`. without a `session_env_path` check, the new capture hook could run in nested reviews and duplicate implement-session reads into review logs.

python/larch/design/clarify.py:1084-1099 [scope-reduction] clarify-only transcript wiring leaves other design log-publish callers uncovered and duplicates step 5c capture. scenario: `design_publish.publish_core` already captures via `_run_log_publish_after_capture` before `design log-publish`, but `clarify.py` and `design_pause.py` invoke `design log-publish` directly with no capture (`design_pause.py:219-234`). a clarify-only patch fixes one gap, adds a second capture implementation, and still misses pause publishes on log-publishing paths the issue requires

standalone review step 0 can skip or misbind the source snapshot because it uses `session_id` instead of the session key `token claude-source` expects, and it does not enforce `session_uuid` matching before writing `claude-source.env`.

skills/review/skill.md:75-106; python/larch/review/review_tally.py:1259-1273 [scope-reduction] do not add session-transcript to the generic review log-phase path. scenario: the planned nested guard wraps direct capture and commit only. the existing run_id log-phase block also runs for nested /review inside /implement, so adding session-transcript there can bypass the guard and write or attempt a raw review transcript under the parent run.
